workspace.text:

Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00, 14:30
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Thanks, Alison

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've checked the calendars and Thursday at 14:30 works for both Elena and David. Please go ahead and book the 30-minute meeting for that time. Once you've done that, I'll send the confirmation email. Thanks, Brad

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Great, I've booked the meeting for Thursday at 14:30. Over to you to send the confirmation.

emails.body:
Dear partners,

This email is to confirm a 30-minute partners' meeting has been scheduled for next week.

Time: Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 14:30 Eastern
Attendees: Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor

A calendar invitation from our booking system has been sent to you separately.

Best regards,

Brad
Scheduling Assistant
